title: Basic Card Layout
spec: Create a page with a single 'card' div. Inside the card, have an 'h2' with text 'Card Title' and a 'p' with text 'This is the card content.'. The card should have a background color of #F0F0F0, a padding of 15px, and a border-radius of 8px. The h2 should be #333333 and the p should be #666666.

title: Alert Message Box
spec: Design an 'alert' div containing a 'span' for an icon (e.g., '⚠') and a 'p' for the message 'Warning: Something went wrong.'. The alert box should have a background of #FFF3CD, a border of 1px solid #FFECB3, padding of 10px, and text color #856404. The span should be bold.

title: Navigation Bar
spec: Create a 'nav' element with a 'ul' inside. The ul should contain three 'li' elements, each with an 'a' link ('Home', 'About', 'Contact'). The nav should have a background of #333333. The li elements should display inline, and the a links should be #FFFFFF, have no underline, and 10px padding.

title: Simple Button Style
spec: Add a 'button' element with the text 'Click Me'. The button should have a background of #007BFF, text color #FFFFFF, padding of 10px 20px, a border-radius of 5px, and no border. On hover, the background should change to #0056b3.

title: Profile Header
spec: Create a 'profile-header' div. Inside, include an 'img' (e.g., placeholder.png) with class 'profile-pic' and an 'h1' with text 'John Doe'. The profile-header should be centered with a max-width of 300px. The image should be a circle (border-radius 50%) with a 2px solid #DDDDDD border. The h1 should be #333333 and centered.

title: Pricing Table Item
spec: Design a 'pricing-item' div. Inside, include an 'h3' (Plan Name), a 'p' (Price: $10/month), and a 'button' (Buy Now). The pricing-item should have a border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding of 20px, and text-align center. The h3 should be #007BFF. The button should be similar to t004 but with a background of #28A745.

title: Image Gallery Item
spec: Create a 'gallery-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., gallery.jpg) and a 'p' (Image Caption). The gallery-item should have a border of 1px solid #CCCCCC and a padding of 5px. The image should be 100% width of its parent. The caption should be #555555 and font-size 0.9em.

title: Form Input Field
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'form-group'. Inside, a 'label' (Email:) and an 'input' of type text. The label should be #333333. The input should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border, 8px padding, and a border-radius of 4px. On focus, the border should change to #007BFF.

title: Numbered List Styling
spec: Style an 'ol' with three 'li' items (Item 1, Item 2, Item 3). The list items should have a bottom border of 1px dotted #BBBBBB. The text color should be #444444. The list markers should be colored #007BFF.

title: Blockquote with Attribution
spec: Create a 'blockquote' with a 'p' (This is a profound quote.) and a 'footer' (— Author Name). The blockquote should have a left border of 5px solid #AAAAAA, padding of 15px, and font-style italic. The footer should be #777777 and text-align right.

title: Feature Box
spec: Design a 'feature-box' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Awesome Feature) and a 'p' (Short description of the feature.). The feature-box should have a background of #E9F5FF, padding of 20px, and a subtle box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.1). The h3 should be #0056b3.

title: Call to Action Section
spec: Create a 'cta-section' div. It contains an 'h2' (Ready to Start?) and a 'button' (Get Started Now!). The cta-section should have a background of #6C757D, padding of 30px, and text-align center. The h2 should be #FFFFFF. The button should have a background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

title: Product Listing Item
spec: Design a 'product-item' div. Inside, an 'img' (product.jpg), an 'h4' (Product Name), and a 'span' (Price: $29.99). The product-item should have a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and text-align center. The image should be 150px wide. The span should be bold and #DC3545.

title: Team Member Card
spec: Create a 'team-member' div. Inside, an 'img' (member.jpg), an 'h3' (Jane Doe), and a 'p' (Role/Title). The team-member should have a background of #FFFFFF, border-radius 10px, box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), and text-align center. The image should be 120px circular. The h3 should be #333333.

title: Footer Section
spec: Design a 'footer' element. Inside, a 'p' (© 2023 My Website) and a 'ul' with two 'li' items (Privacy, Terms). The footer should have a background of #343A40, padding of 20px, and text-align center. The p should be #AAAAAA. The ul li should display inline and the text color should be #AAAAAA with 15px margin-right.

title: Testimonial Block
spec: Create a 'testimonial' div. Inside, a 'p' (This product is amazing!) and a 'span' (— Customer Name). The testimonial should have a background of #F8F9FA, padding of 20px, and border-left 4px solid #007BFF. The p should be italic. The span should be #666666 and text-align right.

title: Status Indicator
spec: Design a 'status-box' div. Inside, a 'span' with class 'status-icon' (e.g., '✓') and a 'p' (Status: Active). The status-box should have a border of 1px solid #28A745 and a background of #D4EDDA. The status-icon should be #28A745 and font-weight bold. The p should be #155724.

title: Article Header
spec: Create an 'article-header' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Article Title) and a 'p' (Published on: Jan 1, 2023). The article-header should have a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE and padding-bottom 15px. The h1 should be #333333 and font-size 2.5em. The p should be #777777 and font-size 0.9em.

title: Interactive List Item
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'list-item'. Inside, a 'span' (Item Name) and a 'button' (Edit). The list-item should have a border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 10px, and display flex with space-between. The button should have a background #FFC107, text #333333, and no border.

title: Hero Section with Background
spec: Design a 'hero-section' div. Inside, an 'h1' (Welcome to Our Site) and a 'p' (Your journey starts here.). The hero-section should have a background-image (e.g., url(hero-bg.jpg)), a background-size cover, min-height 300px, text-align center, and text color #FFFFFF. The h1 should be font-size 3em.

title: Progress Bar
spec: Create a 'div' with id 'progress-container'. Inside, a 'div' with id 'progress-bar'. The container should have a background #E0E0E0 and a height of 20px, border-radius 10px. The progress-bar should have a background #007BFF, a height of 100%, and a width of 50% (example value), also border-radius 10px.

title: Toggle Switch
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'toggle-switch'. Inside, a 'label' and an 'input' of type checkbox. The toggle-switch should have a specific width (e.g., 60px) and height (e.g., 34px). The label should visually represent the switch, with a background of #CCCCCC when unchecked, and #2196F3 when checked. Use pseudo-elements for the 'thumb'.

title: Dropdown Menu Item
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'dropdown-item'. Inside, an 'a' link (Menu Link). The dropdown-item should have padding 10px 15px. The 'a' should be #333333 and have no underline. On hover, the dropdown-item's background should change to #F8F9FA and the text color to #007BFF.

title: Tag/Badge Component
spec: Design a 'span' with class 'tag'. It contains text 'New Feature'. The tag should have a background of #17A2B8, text color #FFFFFF, padding 5px 10px, and a border-radius of 15px. Font-size 0.8em.

title: User Comment Block
spec: Create a 'comment-block' div. Inside, an 'h4' (User Name) and a 'p' (This is a comment.). The comment-block should have a background of #F8F8F8, border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 5px. The h4 should be #007BFF.

title: Breadcrumb Navigation
spec: Create a 'nav' with class 'breadcrumb'. Inside, a 'ul' with three 'li' items (Home, Category, Current Page), each containing an 'a' link. The li elements should display inline with a '»' separator (using pseudo-elements). The 'a' links should be #007BFF, with the last li's 'a' being #6C757D and no link decoration.

title: Pagination Link
spec: Design an 'a' element with class 'page-link' and text '1'. It should have a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 8px 12px, text color #007BFF, and no underline. On hover, the background should be #F8F9FA. For an active page, the background should be #007BFF and text color #FFFFFF.

title: Loading Spinner
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'spinner'. This div should be a circle (e.g., 50px width/height, border-radius 50%) with a 4px solid #F3F3F3 border and a 4px solid #007BFF top border. Animate it to spin indefinitely.

title: Modal Header
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'modal-header'. Inside, an 'h3' (Modal Title) and a 'button' (x). The modal-header should have a background of #F8F9FA, padding 15px, and a bottom border of 1px solid #EEEEEE. It should display flex with space-between. The button should have no background/border, font-size 1.5em, and text #AAAAAA.

title: Cookie Consent Banner
spec: Create a 'div' with id 'cookie-banner'. Inside, a 'p' (We use cookies...) and a 'button' (Accept). The banner should be fixed at the bottom of the viewport, have a background #333333, text color #FFFFFF, padding 15px, and display flex with align-items center. The button should be #28A745.

title: Image with Overlay Caption
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'image-container'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., scenic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'overlay' containing a 'p' (Beautiful View). The image-container should be positioned relative. The overlay should be positioned absolute, cover the image entirely, have a semi-transparent black background (rgba(0,0,0,0.6)), and center the text #FFFFFF. Initially, the overlay should be hidden and appear on hover.

title: User Avatar with Status Dot
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'avatar-wrapper'. Inside, an 'img' (user.jpg) and a 'span' with class 'status-dot'. The image should be 50px circular. The status-dot should be positioned absolute (e.g., bottom-right of avatar), a small green circle (10px, background #28A745, border-radius 50%), and border 2px solid #FFFFFF.

title: Code Snippet Block
spec: Design a 'pre' element with a 'code' element inside. The code element contains a few lines of code. The pre should have a background of #F8F8F8, border of 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, border-radius 5px, and font-family monospace. The text color should be #333333.

title: Table Row Styling
spec: Style a 'table' with a 'thead' containing 'th' (Header 1, Header 2) and a 'tbody' containing two 'tr' with 'td' (Data 1, Data 2). The table should have a 1px solid #CCCCCC border. The th elements should have a background #F8F8F8 and padding 10px. The td elements should have padding 8px. Alternate rows (tbody tr:nth-child(even)) should have a background #F0F0F0.

title: Chat Bubble (Incoming)
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble incoming'. Inside, a 'p' (Hello there!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #E2E2E2, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 15px 0, max-width 70%, and align to the left. The text color should be #333333.

title: Chat Bubble (Outgoing)
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'chat-bubble outgoing'. Inside, a 'p' (I'm good, thanks!). The chat-bubble should have a background of #007BFF, padding 10px 15px, border-radius 15px 15px 0 15px, max-width 70%, and align to the right using margin-left auto. The text color should be #FFFFFF.

title: Keyboard Shortcut Display
spec: Design a 'span' with class 'kbd'. It contains text 'Ctrl + C'. The kbd element should have a background of #EEEEEE, border of 1px solid #BBBBBB, padding 3px 6px, border-radius 3px, font-family monospace, and font-size 0.9em.

title: Video Thumbnail
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'video-thumbnail'. Inside, an 'img' (video.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'play-icon' (e.g., '▶'). The thumbnail should be positioned relative. The play-icon should be positioned absolute in the center, a large white triangle on a semi-transparent black circle, and font-size 2em.

title: Notification Dot
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'icon-wrapper'. Inside, an 'i' (e.g., a bell icon) and a 'span' with class 'notification-dot'. The icon-wrapper should be positioned relative. The notification-dot should be positioned absolute (e.g., top-right of icon), a small red circle (8px, background #DC3545, border-radius 50%), and display block.

title: Accordion Header
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'accordion-header'. Inside, an 'h4' (Section Title) and a 'span' (▼). The header should have a background of #F8F9FA, border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and display flex with space-between and align-items center. The span should be #666666.

title: Horizontal Rule with Text
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'separator'. Inside, a 'span' (OR). The separator should have a top and bottom border (1px solid #DDDDDD). The span should be positioned absolute, have a background of #FFFFFF, padding 0 10px, and text color #777777, effectively 'cutting' the line.

title: Empty State Message
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'empty-state'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., empty-folder.png) and a 'p' (No items found.). The empty-state should be text-align center, have a padding of 30px, and a border of 1px dashed #CCCCCC. The image should be 80px wide. The p should be #666666.

title: Checkmark List
spec: Create a 'ul' with class 'checkmark-list'. It contains three 'li' items (Feature 1, Feature 2, Feature 3). Each li should have a checkmark icon (e.g., '✓') as a pseudo-element before the text. The checkmark should be green (#28A745) and the text black (#333333).

title: Rating Stars
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'rating'. It contains five 'span' elements, each with a star character (★). The stars should be gold (#FFC107) for the first three, and grey (#DDDDDD) for the remaining two (representing a 3-star rating).

title: Scroll-to-Top Button
spec: Create a 'button' with id 'scroll-top'. It contains an arrow icon (▲). The button should be fixed to the bottom-right of the viewport, have a background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, 50px width/height, and a box-shadow: 0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2). Initially hidden, appears on scroll.

title: Segmented Control Item
spec: Design an 'a' element with class 'segment-item' and text 'Option 1'. It should have a border of 1px solid #007BFF, padding 8px 15px, text color #007BFF, and border-radius (e.g., for left/right ends of a group). For an active item, the background should be #007BFF and text #FFFFFF.

title: File Upload Dropzone
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'dropzone'. Inside, a 'p' (Drag & drop files here or click to upload). The dropzone should have a border of 2px dashed #007BFF, background #F0F8FF, padding 30px, text-align center, and text color #007BFF. On hover, the border should become solid.

title: Skill Bar
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'skill-bar-container'. Inside, a 'div' with class 'skill-bar-fill'. The container should have a background #E0E0E0, height 15px, and border-radius 8px. The fill should have a background #28A745, height 100%, and a width of 75% (example value), also border-radius 8px.

title: Recipe Ingredient List
spec: Create a 'ul' with class 'ingredients'. It contains three 'li' items (1 cup flour, 2 eggs, 1/2 tsp salt). Each li should have a bullet point, padding 5px, and a bottom border of 1px dotted #DDDDDD. Text color should be #444444.

title: Social Media Icon Link
spec: Design an 'a' element with class 'social-icon' and an 'i' (e.g., a Font Awesome icon class like 'fa fa-facebook'). The link should be a circle (e.g., 40px, border-radius 50%), have a background of #3B5998, text color #FFFFFF, and text-align center with line-height for vertical centering. On hover, the background should darken slightly.

title: Event Card
spec: Create an 'event-card' div. Inside, an 'h3' (Event Title), a 'p' with class 'date' (Date: Jan 1, 2024), and a 'p' with class 'location' (Location: City Hall). The event-card should have a background of #FFFFFF, border 1px solid #EEEEEE, padding 15px, and border-radius 8px. The date should be bold and #007BFF. The location should be #6C757D.

title: Input with Addon
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'input-group'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'addon' (e.g., '@') and an 'input' of type text. The input-group should display flex. The addon should have a background #E9ECEF, border 1px solid #CED4DA, padding 8px 12px, border-right: none. The input should have a 1px solid #CED4DA border, padding 8px, and border-left: none. Round the corners appropriately for a combined look.

title: Countdown Timer Digit
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'timer-digit'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'value' (e.g., '05') and a 'span' with class 'label' (e.g., 'Days'). The timer-digit should have a background #343A40, text-align center, padding 10px, and border-radius 5px. The value should be large (font-size 2.5em) and #FFFFFF. The label should be smaller (font-size 0.8em) and #AAAAAA.

title: Scrollable Content Area
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'scrollable-area'. Inside, a 'p' with 10-15 lines of lorem ipsum text. The scrollable-area should have a fixed height (e.g., 200px), a border of 1px solid #DDDDDD, padding 10px, and overflow-y: scroll. The text color should be #333333.

title: Highlight Box
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'highlight-box'. Inside, an 'h3' (Important Note) and a 'p' (This is a highlighted piece of information.). The highlight-box should have a background of #FFF3CD, border-left 5px solid #FFC107, padding 15px, and border-radius 4px. The h3 should be #856404.

title: Step Indicator
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'step'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'step-number' (e.g., '1') and a 'p' (Step Description). The step should have display flex and align-items center. The step-number should be a circle (e.g., 30px, background #007BFF, text #FFFFFF, border-radius 50%, text-align center, line-height 30px) with 10px right margin. The p should be #333333.

title: File List Item
spec: Create a 'div' with class 'file-item'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'file-icon' (e.g., '🖹') and a 'a' (document.pdf). The file-item should have padding 8px, border-bottom 1px solid #EEEEEE, and display flex with align-items center. The file-icon should be #6C757D and 10px right margin. The 'a' should be #007BFF with no underline.

title: Coupon Code Box
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'coupon-box'. Inside, a 'span' with class 'code' (e.g., 'SAVE10') and a 'button' (Copy). The coupon-box should have a border of 2px dashed #28A745, background #D4EDDA, padding 10px, display flex, and justify-content space-between. The code should be bold and #155724. The button should have background #28A745 and text #FFFFFF.

title: User Permissions List
spec: Create a 'ul' with class 'permissions-list'. It contains three 'li' items (Read, Write, Delete). Each li should have a checkbox input before its text. The text color should be #333333 and li padding 5px.

title: Image Grid Item
spec: Design a 'div' with class 'grid-item'. Inside, an 'img' (e.g., grid-pic.jpg) and a 'div' with class 'title' (Image Title). The grid-item should have a border 1px solid #DDDDDD, overflow hidden, and position relative. The image should be 100% width. The title should be positioned absolute at the bottom, have a background rgba(0,0,0,0.7), padding 5px, text #FFFFFF, and 100% width.
